# ELMS LMP2 — data quality

Lap accounting for **all 25 race-seasons** of this class, one row each. Not a sample: the per-series version of this report accounted for the races its author had loaded, which for IMSA was 10 of 140.

**35,750 raw laps, 24,978 kept (69.9%)**, median 70.1% per race.

Each lap is dropped by exactly one stage, in this order, so the columns sum to the raw total:

| stage | laps | what it removes |
|---|---|---|
| non-green or pit | 5,272 | neutralised, in-lap, out-lap |
| missing tyre age | 0 | no stint reconstruction possible |
| field-wide trim | 2,447 | a lap the whole field ran slowly — a neutralisation ramp or standing start the flags missed |
| per-car trim | 2,914 | each car's slowest residuals, after the first-pass fit |
| too few car laps | 139 | cars with too little running to carry a fixed effect |
